environment.description: ASP.NET Core 7 application deployed on AKS with Istio service mesh. PostgreSQL 15 on CloudNativePG operator with connection pooling via PgBouncer in transaction mode. Database session variable 'app.current_tenant' is set via a custom DbConnection interceptor on each connection checkout. PostgreSQL RLS policy on documents table: CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON documents USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')::uuid) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant')::uuid). Policy is FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY enabled on the 'app_service' role. Additionally, Istio's EnvoyFilter applies a Lua script that strips any response header matching pattern 'X-*-Duration*' and adds random jitter (50-200ms) to all response times via a fault injection filter with fixedDelay. The PgBouncer transaction pooling means SET LOCAL commands scope the tenant context per-transaction, and the RLS policy ensures even if the WHERE clause is bypassed or the cross-tenant path is hit, the database itself will never return rows belonging to another tenant.

config.session_variable_interceptor: EF Core IDbConnectionInterceptor sets 'SET LOCAL app.current_tenant = {tenantId}' on ConnectionOpened
config.istio_envoy_filter: lua response header strip for X-*-Duration* pattern, fault.injection.fixedDelay 50-200ms random
config.network_policy: deny-all with explicit allow for app->pgbouncer:5432 only
